experiment: Fixed-gate stress controls: close unequal attacks, uncertain slow rises, and polyphonic entries
sample_format: mono little-endian f32, exactly 48000 frames, original frame-zero origin

construction.burst: For ages 0..127 inclusive: amplitude * exp(-age/24) * cos(TAU*3000*age/48000); all other frames zero; sum voices in f64 then cast once to f32
construction.hard_tone: From start through EOF: amplitude * cos(TAU*frequency_hz*age/48000); zero before start; sum voices in f64 then cast once to f32
construction.slow_tone: From start through EOF: amplitude * envelope * cos(TAU*440*age/48000), envelope = (1-cos(PI*age/rise_frames))/2 for 0<=age<rise_frames and 1 afterward; zero before start; cast once to f32
construction.tail_policy: No manufactured release or tail padding; burst support ends after age127; sustained tones continue through file EOF without asserting a note-off event
construction.burst_tail: The age127 sample is not forced to zero, so the abrupt finite-support cutoff is retained; any resulting extra candidate is scored as an extra, not silently excluded

label_policy.discrete: Literal hard-entry frames identify designed acoustic source activations with nonzero first samples, not perceptually annotated onsets, beats, downbeats, or playable Anchors
label_policy.slow: Envelope support start and full-amplitude boundary are known; there is no unique declared perceptual onset. The inclusive interval is a construction-defined observation region, not a calibrated human-annotation confidence interval. truth_frames and both metrics remain null
label_policy.close_matcher_ambiguity: The 384-frame pair lies within the unchanged 480-frame matching tolerance. Chronological one-to-one maximum-cardinality matching is retained; inspect recorded pairs and original peak coordinates, and do not identify the missed physical voice solely from matched-pair assignment
label_policy.analysis_blinding: Generate and analyze PCM before labels enter the unchanged matcher; no truth-driven shifts, threshold sweeps, frame-zero additions, per-case tuning, or new candidate creation
label_policy.admission: Keep all earlier failures and native/filtered outcomes; success on these engineering controls cannot establish MusicAnalysis admission; real music, canonical Ogg readback, independent human labels, beat, confidence and Anchor quality remain NOT RUN
label_policy.causal_attribution: The 384-frame pair shares both native picker mean context and gate denominator context; a missing native candidate cannot be attributed to the gate. Record both output lists and both metrics
